$comment: Reference for `e2e-conformance.json`. Copy this into a workbench app's
directory to run the e2e suite against an app that is not written in
"language": anything other than "javascript" skips the tests marked
`testJsOnly` / `describeJsOnly` in e2e.test.ts — the ones whose subject is
the JS implementation rather than the workflow protocol.
"fixtures": the workflows/99_e2e fixtures this app implements. A test whose
fixture is not listed is skipped; a fixture that is listed but missing from
the deployed manifest fails the run, so the list cannot silently rot.
Grow it as fixtures are ported; never shrink it without saying why.
